individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrographs (photoactivation time-lapse images), not a plot of averaged data, so individual data point display is not applicable.

Panel B shows line/scatter plots of normalized intensity vs. time; the main curves already plot the individual raw measurement points with a fitted model line, and the insets show averaged early time-point responses as scatter points with error bars over time (a line-type plot). Line/scatter plots of this kind are exempt from the individual-data-point overlay requirement.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - Panel A is a set of micrographs with no plotted error bars or box-plot elements.

FAIL - The inset plots in panel B display data points with visible error bars (vertical caps) representing variability in the averaged early time-point responses, but the caption does not state what these error bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM, or CI).
